name: The Pin
about: Scrum Master 3's LIVE The Pin, on demand: the Judge's pin (probe A3) and the sealed core's seal (A5 and every B) from the lie detector's own report, said together. Red names your one step; it never fixes.

facts.rerun: cd ~/virtual_workspace/lryllm/lryllm/app && env -u PYTHONPATH PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 WID_ENV=localhost.rnd ~/virtual_workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "from core_engine import cebf; r = cebf.run(); print(r['at'], r['verdict'], r['pass'], 'pass', r['fail'], 'fail', r['no_data'], 'no data')"
facts.pin_and_reseal: run PIN AND RESEAL yourself, by hand in the terminal (your hand tool, your fingerprint once): it seals the vaults and the core and re-pins; then press RUN on The Pin and on Lie Detector

card.pitch: The Judge and the sealed core still match their pin
